sloka: अहम् गमिष्यामि वनम् सुदुर्गमम् ।मृग आयुतम् वानर वारणैः युतम् ।वने निवत्स्यामि यथा पितुर् गृहे ।तव एव पादाव् उपगृह्य सम्मता ॥२-२७-२१॥
transliteration: aham gamiṣyāmi vanam sudurgamam ।mṛga āyutam vānara vāraṇaiḥ yutam ।vane nivatsyāmi yathā pitur gṛhe ।tava eva pādāv upagṛhya sammatā ॥2-27-21॥

translations.english: I shall go (along with you) to the highly impenetrable forest infested with animals like monkeys and elephants. I shall live in the forest in (full) discipline as in my father's abode, taking shelter at your feet.
